instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz in der indirekten Rede, indem du das Verb in der richtigen Zeitform auswählst.

atoms.b: Shane told Becky that Kacey ((++was is has_been)) funny.

atoms.a: Hendrick told Tim, “I am eating a sandwich for lunch.”
atoms.b: Hendrick told Tim that he ((++was_eating is_eating had_been_eating)) a sandwich for lunch.

atoms.a: Cassandra said, “I swam a mile yesterday.”
atoms.b: Cassandra said that she ((++had_swum has_swum swam)) a mile the day before.

atoms.a: Brooke said, “I was reading a book when my parents arrived.”
atoms.b: Brooke said that he ((++had_been_reading was_reading is_reading)) a book when his parents arrived.

atoms.a: George said, “I have just seen the film in the cinema.”
atoms.b: George said that he ((++had_just_seen has_just_seen just_saw)) the film in the cinema.

atoms.a: Trixie said, “I have been cleaning my room all morning.”
atoms.b: Trixie said that she ((++had_been_cleaning has_been_cleaning was_cleaning)) her room all morning.

feedback.wrong: present perfect progressive → past perfect progressive

instruction.text: Vervollständige den Satz in der indirekten Rede, indem du das Verb in der richtigen Zeitform in die Lücken schreibst.

atoms.a: Meryem told Lena, “The German exam is easy.”
atoms.b: Meryem told Lena that the German exam ((was)) easy.

atoms.a: Tayfun told Rian, “Ben is playing football with Tim and Ahmed.”
atoms.b: Tayfun told Rian that Ben ((was_playing)) football with Tim and Ahmed.

atoms.a: Wendy said, “I broke my arm last week.”
atoms.b: Wendy said that she ((had_broken)) her arm the week before.

atoms.a: Thomas said, “I was walking to the underground station when it started to rain.”
atoms.b: Thomas said that he ((had_been_walking)) to the underground station when it started to rain.

atoms.a: Dan said, “I have been to New Orleans before.”
atoms.b: Dan said he ((had_been)) to New Orleans before.

atoms.a: Sude said, “I have been studying for the physics exam all week.”
atoms.b: Sude said that she ((had_been_studying)) for the physics exam all week.
atoms.sound: Su de said that she had been studying for the physics exam all week.
